audit_title: CRISPR Guide AI Final Claim Verification & Task Status Report

status_categories.Implemented: Software feature, pipeline, API endpoint, or UI component successfully developed and functioning.
status_categories.Executed: Experimental script, training pipeline, or benchmark successfully executed on real data.
status_categories.Independently verified: Empirical results independently recalculated and traced to ground-truth artifacts with 0 discrepancy.
status_categories.Incomplete: Evaluation performed but statistically limited, underpowered, or requiring additional external data.
status_categories.Not possible with available data: Requested task cannot be executed because requisite raw data is absent from repository distribution.

tasks.verdict: Unresolved in Benchmark Literature / Mislabeled. Coordinates map 100% to Doench 2016 A375 melanoma screen across 8 genes (PMID: 26780180), but distributed as hek293t.repisgt by DeepCRISPR and hek293.csv by CRISPRpredSEQ. Officially designated 'A375 (Doench 2016)'.
Corrected. Unsupported causal claims of 'steric crowding' and 'guide-guide competition' withdrawn. Replaced with documented dataset composition observations (concentration across 8 genes / 11 loci).
Executed for HeLa, HCT116, HL60. Re-designated as '50-kb genomic-window-grouped validation'. Grouping on HEK293/A375 marked Incomplete due to low group count (G=11).

Executed and traced. Decomposed HeLa-HCT116 transfer into seen guides (78.7% overlap, r=0.4470) and novel unseen guides (21.3%, r=0.2470). Reclassified from external validation to cross-cell-line transfer.
Not executed. Raw HEL records were not included in the public repository release. Formally documented as unexecuted.
Corrected. Re-designated strictly as 'fixed historical holdout partition'. Claims of pristine/untouched quarantine removed; prior inspection disclosed.
Corrected. Fold-level paired t-tests replaced with instance-level paired Wilcoxon tests on OOF predictions and 1,000 instance bootstrap CIs with Holm-Bonferroni correction.
Corrected. Informal '>95% predictive power' claim removed. Replaced with exact observed differences: position-specific features (444 feats) match full feature set within Delta r <= 0.01 across lines.
Disambiguated. Re-labeled as Literature-Reported Baseline Comparison. Clarified that third-party code was not re-executed on our specific partition.
Corrected. RF tree dispersion explicitly designated 'ensemble disagreement / empirical dispersion'. Claims of calibrated prediction intervals removed.
Verified. Throughput (1860 seq/s), memory footprint (+95.1 MB), and Ridge inference (495.3 guides/s) confirmed. Reason for ensemble runtime difference (pure Python tree loops) documented.
Verified. 26/26 backend tests pass. Frontend builds cleanly. Ordinary UI remains completely unpolluted by internal diagnostic controls.
